#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed RuneScape: Dragonwilds server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/dragonwilds/gamedash-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/dragonwilds/gamedash-servers/test/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/DedicatedServer.ini" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
t = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8").read()
for key, val in (("WorldPassword", sys.argv[2]),):
    line = key + "=" + val
    if re.search(r'(?m)^%s=' % key, t):
        t = re.sub(r'(?m)^%s=.*$' % key, lambda m: line, t, count=1)
    else:
        t = re.sub(r'(?m)^(\[/Script/Dominion\.DedicatedServerSettings\])$', lambda m: m.group(1) + '\n' + line, t, count=1)
open(sys.argv[1], "w", encoding="utf-8").write(t)
SYNC
cd "<ROOT>/installs/dragonwilds/" || exit 1
exec ./RSDragonwilds/Binaries/Linux/RSDragonwildsServer-Linux-Shipping RSDragonwilds -log -userdir="<ROOT>/installs/dragonwilds/gamedash-servers/test" -Port=7790
